| `Comparator` | Class | A single version constraint: a comparison operator applied to a version. Comparator strings accept an optional operator prefix (`=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`) followed by a complete version; a missing operator means `=`. Wildcards and range sugar are not allowed — those belong to `Range`. | check if a version satisfies an operator constraint, single comparator like >=1.2.3 |
| `ComparatorSet` | TypeAlias | A comparator set: comparators combined with AND semantics. A version must satisfy every comparator in the set to match. | |
| `EmptyCacheError` | Class | Indicates that an extremum (`latest`/`oldest`) was requested from an empty cache. | handle empty version cache, no versions loaded, latest or oldest with nothing cached |
| `InvalidComparatorError` | Class | Indicates that a string could not be parsed as a single comparator. | handle malformed comparator string, typed parse failure for a single constraint |
| `InvalidRangeError` | Class | Indicates that a string could not be parsed as a range expression. | handle malformed semver range string, typed parse failure for a range expression |
| `InvalidVersionError` | Class | Indicates that a string could not be parsed as a valid SemVer 2.0.0 version. | handle malformed version string, typed parse failure, not valid semver |
| `Range` | Class | A SemVer range expression: a union (OR) of {@link ComparatorSet}s. Supports node-semver syntax — hyphen ranges (`1.0.0 - 2.0.0`), X-ranges (`1.x`, `*`), tilde (`~1.2.3`), caret (`^1.2.3`) and `\|\|` unions — which parsing desugars into primitive comparators and normalizes. | parse and match a semver range, does a version satisfy a range, npm-style ranges (hyphen, x-range, tilde, caret, \|\|) |
| `SemVer` | Class | A parsed SemVer 2.0.0 version: an Effect `Schema.Class` whose fields are validated in-schema (non-negative integer components, well-formed identifiers), so `SemVer.make` only produces valid versions. | parse and validate a semver version string, compare versions, bump major minor patch |
| `SemVerBump` | Class | Grouped bump operations returned by the {@link SemVer.bump} accessor. Every operation returns a new {@link SemVer}; build metadata never survives a bump. | bump a version, increment major minor patch prerelease or build metadata |
| `UnsatisfiableConstraintError` | Class | Indicates that intersecting ranges produced no satisfiable comparator set. | handle impossible intersected ranges, no comparator set can satisfy both ranges |
| `UnsatisfiedRangeError` | Class | Indicates that the cache contains versions but none satisfies the requested range. Carries the range and the versions that were available, and is fully serializable — both payload fields are schema classes. | handle no cached version matching a range, report available versions against the requested range |
| `VersionCache` | Class | An in-memory sorted version cache: mutation, query, resolution and navigation over a set of {@link SemVer} versions ordered by SemVer precedence. Pure state (a `Ref` of a sorted array) — no IO. | track and query a set of available versions, find latest oldest or next satisfying a range, resolve dependency version |
| `VersionCacheShape` | Interface | Operations of the {@link VersionCache} service. | |
| `VersionDiff` | Class | The difference between two {@link SemVer} versions: the classification of the change plus signed numeric deltas. A `Schema.TaggedClass` — the one concept in this package where serialized tag discrimination earns its keep. | classify the change between two versions, diff semver versions, is this a major minor or patch bump |
| `VersionNotFoundError` | Class | Indicates that a navigation operation (`diff`/`next`/`prev`) referenced a version that is not in the cache. | handle a version missing from the cache during diff next or prev navigation |
